neighbours.label: pieces of famous historical, biblical or composer names ('Tscha|ik|owsky', ' Cain', 'Arch|im|edes', 'Push|kin')
fire: We heard a concert of Tchaikovsky at the town hall.
The sermon explained why Cain killed his brother in the field.
The history teacher told us how Archimedes shouted in the bath.
My grandfather kept an old recording of Tchaikovsky in the attic.
The Bible tells how Abel and Cain brought their offerings.
The professor's lecture on Lutoslawski filled the room.
They translated a long poem by Pushkin into English.
The composer Stravinsky admired the ballets of Tchaikovsky.
quiet: We heard a concert of the school band at the town hall.
The sermon explained why Tom left his brother in the field.
The history teacher told us how Brian shouted in the hall.
My grandfather kept an old recording of the news in the attic.
The farmer tells how Mike and Steve brought their tractors.
The professor's lecture on rainfall filled the room.
They translated a long letter by a bumpkin into English.
The neighbor Jones admired the roses of Mrs. Clark.
